//: The config the test runner transpiles against.
`tsx` applies compiler options only to files the resolved project covers, and
the three build projects each cover one directory: `src`, `components/ui`, or
`components/custom-ui`. A test that imports across all of them would have no
single project to be read under, and its components would be transpiled with
the classic JSX runtime, so every render would throw `React is not defined`.
This project spans the whole package for that one purpose. It emits nothing,
